$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFNC (AIP France, chart dated 2023-02-23): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Mont-Dauphin - Saint-Crépin

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: Simultaneous use of paved RWY and glider unpaved RWY prohibited.
Possible presence of very high snow embankments on the edge of RWY.

Excluding communication related to safety requirements, aircraft entering the traffic pattern are requested to be at least two minutes on frequency to ensure that there is no winching operation in progress, the use of the frequency may interfere with communication between the operator and the glider pilot.
Grass acceleration surface 200 x 50 m on paved RWY 16 usable only for paved RWY 16 take-offs.
RWY 16 holding point: no obligation sign.
Caution advised when taxiing outside of RWY.
No taxi West of paved RWY.
November apron (grass): do not overshoot the ground markings (yellow cones) on TWY side.
Heavy gliding activity from March 01st to September 30 th.
Aerobatics (NR 6935): Axis 159°/339° 2000 m length, centered over ARP, 4000 ft AMSL/8200 ft AMSL, HJ, activity reserved for gliders.
Glider winching activity (NR 994) West from paved RWY 16/34 MAX cable ALT: 5000 ft AMSL (unbeaconed).
During winch activity, do not perform recognition flight below 5000 ft AMSL.
Loss of altitude area for gliders to join circuit: MontDauphin Vauban fort.
